---
id: nile-crocodile
title: Nile crocodile
---
The Nile crocodile (*Crocodylus niloticus*) ambushes ungulates and fish
along African rivers and lakes. A four-chambered heart and a palatal
valve let it hold a drowning ungulate underwater while still breathing
through the snout. Parental care includes carrying hatchlings. Basking
sets muscle temperature. Osteoderms armour the back.
